verdict.rationale: Mercury documents card limits, spend controls, and approvals (also managing spending limits via the Cards API), and a long-time customer confirms hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits plus purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules. That gives automatically enforced limits per card or account, which can approximate program budgets. The evidence never shows a department- or program-level budget object that pools and enforces spend across cards or users, so budgets must be built from individual card limits and separate accounts. missing for 10: native department/program budget entity, budget-level enforcement across multiple cards/users, documentation of budget tracking or alerts.
